evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds two new RPC commands (`setprunelock` and `listprunelocks`) in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp`.
rationale: Adds `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` RPCs to resolve a distinct gap where external wallets and indexers (such as electrs) lose required blocks when running against pruned nodes. Downstream consumers explicitly requested and verified this functionality to prevent rescan race conditions.
